Author: Krishan Pahal

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 13581 of 2023
Applicant :- Shamim Ahamad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashutosh Kumar Pandey

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.

2. Heard Sri Ashutosh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Sunil Kumar,
learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No.366 of 2021, registered under Sections 419, 420 I.P.C., 16 of Indian Medical Counsel Act and 18,
Shamim Ahamad vs State Of U.P.And Another on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115449202/
1 27 of Drugs and Cosmetic Act, at Police Station- Robertsganj, District- Sonbhadra with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Shamim Ahamad vs State Of U.P.And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. As per prosecution story, the applicant was found selling certain medicines without any licence,
issued by the CMO, Sonbhadra, by the police and the team of Chief Medical Officer concerned on 5.7.2021.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that he has been falsely implicated in this case.
Learned counsel has stated that no medicine has been found to be spurious, as such no case is made out against the applicant.
There is no criminal antecedent of the applicant.
Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
The applicant has apprehension of his arrest.

Learned counsel has stated that the applicant undertakes that he has co-operated in the investigation and is ready to do so in trial also failing which the State can move appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail.
6.
Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the anticipatory bail application.

7. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicant, the applicant is liable to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the judgment of Supreme Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1".

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicant shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of the Apex Court.
8. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

entities.text: Shamim Ahamad vs State Of U.P.And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. It is made clear that observations made hereinabove are exclusively for deciding the instant anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the trial.
